exposure: Fetal middle cerebral artery pulsatility index
fetal middle cerebral artery pulsatility indexes
cohort: 181 pregnant women with 38-40 weeks of gestational age
finding: A low fetal middle cerebral artery pulsatility index and umbilical artery Doppler ratio were significantly associated with fetal distress, abnormal monitoring, and urgent cesarean.
mod_finding: A low fetal middle cerebral artery pulsatility index and umbilical artery Doppler ratio were significantly associated with urgent cesarean.
